tui.chrome.remote_park.approval_remainde: Allowing it happens on {device} (Touch ID) or on a phone paired with it. If nothing there can check a signature: ask Local Operator to set up operator authority there (one approval and one admin password prompt) — if that device is running an older build, updating it is what fixes that.
tui.chrome.remote_park.approval_remedy: Allowing it happens on {device} (Touch ID) or on a phone paired with it. If {device} cannot check a signature yet, this machine's operator anchor is not installed there: run `lop operator anchor export --file anchor.json` on this machine, copy that file to {device}, then run `lop operator install --from anchor.json` on {device} once (one admin password prompt). That lets {device} check a signature made on this machine; it grants nothing else.
